content: Nahavanti Yesu ma Nazarat biya
Ɗughars ba Yesu kǝ vakava kǝ iin kaa gwiya daas kǝ iin damma kǝsaana, kaa daas kǝ iin ǝmtaɗ dǝ mbǝrzahaana.

Ɓagaa ba sarta ngiiga Yahudaha, kaa farzha kǝ iin kǝ tsagar dǝgit kǝ uudah ma guda dzǝgwazhigǝla. Baɗyak lii cinngaracinnga, ar ɓa jappǝra taakiya, “Tlakǝna mǝr nǝ uudanǝn kwanahaani? Hulfa kwar kǝ sǝrgasǝrgǝr wa vǝlavarvǝlǝg baz dǝga jappǝr ndakwi ɓaagaani?”
“Abi kafintǝn wanǝn? Zǝra Maryam, zǝrabaz Yakub, ard Isuvuu, Yahuda ar dǝ Siman biya? Abi yigahaan ngwasah wan ǝmtaɗ dǝ kǝmyamǝn?” Kaa za vǝgha dǝ iin kǝ iitǝra.
Aiyam Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Aanji ba war fǝgaarafǝg kǝ tlayang, maay ba nǝ uudaha kǝsaan ard zaraabahaan ard lii vǝgyaan biya.”
Ɓagaabi Yesu kǝ dǝga jappǝr vaakwahiin biya, mbǝghana ba uudah hǝɗikǝn tǝdvad fǝtǝra dǝva.
Kaa ɓa jappǝr kǝ iin tǝdvad maayrǝrra fadghǝghǝratǝra. Ɓǝlghantɓǝlǝg Yesu Kǝ Mbǝrzahaana Kaa gwaivagwaig kǝ Yesu ma kyalma gǝdzǝr kǝssah tsagtǝr dǝgita.
Kaa ba ɗahtǝrǝtɗahǝg kǝ iin kǝ kǝlawa tar buna, ɓǝltǝrǝt kǝiin bu-buwa, vǝltǝr dlaɓ kǝ ndzǝɗ tǝghǝr kǝ shiɗkwa shatanaha.
Ɓǝltǝra kǝ maggi taakiya, “Kǝsam bi kǝ dǝgit kwakyarvad dagalaru biya, aanji dǝgzǝga, ma jilada, bi kwaɓ ma mbǝlaharu biya, ba zad kalti wam kǝssǝg nǝ uurama.
Famfǝg ba kǝ kimbaka, kǝsambi kǝ kwatlǝrn kǝ sǝɗav biya aandzǝg ba wa tǝ vǝgharuwa.
Baɗǝm hǝnyahi am dǝgaa nǝ uurama, am ndza vaakwah tangw damma sarti am da ɗuug nǝuuram kǝ kǝssiina
Baɗǝm vakavaki dlǝghakura bi nǝ uud biya, mam da ciiga am pangda kǝ alagwat tǝ shigahaaru kiyava nǝg kǝ shidaharuwa.”
Kaa ciya dagal kǝ iitǝr, ar tagtǝr ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝla kǝ uudah taakiya aa pǝlarpǝlg kǝ ghǝra.
Lagwardalagw kǝ shiɗkwa shatanah baɗyaka, ar mastǝra kǝ wal kǝ lii yangbi baɗyaka, dlaɓa ar mbahtǝrana.
Əmtsǝga Yuhwan Dadda Tsuufǝga

Kaa cinngacinng kǝ tlǝkkǝs Hirudus kǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝ Yesu, aɗaba cinngalcinng nǝ ɗaagaan aanji takwara. Baz tagaan kǝ kyalǝma uudah taakiya, “Yuhwan dadda tsufǝg wa ciyavant ma gǝtlaha, iin wa nǝ iin dǝ ndzǝɗa ɓaa dǝgaha jappǝr nǝ iin ǝnd kwana.”
Aiyam kyalma uudaha, “Tlayang Iliya.” Am kyalma, “maaya, kwatlǝrn kǝ tlayang shah, ma tlayangahi ndza wura.”
Cinngha ba nǝ Hirudus kǝ ǝlbǝgna, aiyama, “Abi, Yuhwan, kwa ghudananai kǝ ghǝr tǝ vakai wa ciyavant ma gǝtlaha!”
Aɗaba wura ndza Hirudus ba dǝ ghǝraan wa taga taakiya aa viivǝtviig Yuhwan nguɗvǝnan ma guda bǝrfina. Ɓagaaɓag Hirudus ndǝkwan mbakyarvad Hirudiya, uusa zǝraabaan Filigus, kwa kǝsuu Hirudus.
Aɗaba ndza taghartag Yuhwan kǝ Hirudus taakiya, “Kalkalaan bi kǝssa uusa zǝrabaabagh biya.”
Mbats, Hirudiya hǝkyaghanahǝkyag kǝ Yuhwan ma ǝrviɗmahuudaana, nahanahǝg maa tsǝvaan, bakǝva kwaha tlakǝna bi kǝ ɗuuli biya,

aɗaba Hirudus gǝdzgaan kǝ Yuhwaana. Sǝrgasǝrg nǝ iin taakiya uuda jiirjiir nǝ iina, dlaɓa ba cuwaɗaɗɗa, iin wa fǝghara kǝ Hirudus kǝ hǝkya Yuhwan ba marawwa. Ba cukw sarti taag Yuhwan kǝ ghaiya dǝ vakaiya, mbǝkǝnmbǝg ma ǝrviɗmahuɗaana, bakǝva vakwaha cinngaan kǝ ǝmtakǝra ǝlbǝgaana.
Tǝhalakwaha kaa tlǝkkǝnatlǝg kǝ uusiin kǝ ɗuula, daavala ɓa kwaanda Hirudus, kwa dzahghant nǝ iin kǝ ajanaha ar dǝ tlǝksaha ghwavahaana, ar dǝ uudahi maamaalah ma Galili kwakyarvad hwaɗaga kwandaana.
Dal ba nǝ dǝghwa Hirudiya da shakalǝg tǝvuukwa Hirudus ar dǝ ghulabahaana, cinngaracinng kǝ mtakǝr ba vaivaiya. Aiyama, “Au wagha naagnǝngi? Baɗǝm dǝgiti aa ghalga nǝng ǝn vǝlakvǝlǝga”.
Baz zangwaɗǝga, am tlǝkǝssa taa kǝ dǝghwna, “Baɗǝm dǝgiti aa ghalga nǝng ǝn vǝlakvǝlǝga, aanji kyalma tlǝkǝssǝrara.”
Kaa dagal kǝ dǝghwǝn tagar kǝ babbaan, “Awanda ghalg naayi?” Aiyam babbaana, “Ghǝra Yuhwan dadda tsuufǝgga.”
Ba tǝ watsǝr kaa ǝmndǝra da vak tlǝkǝs kǝ iin amaa, “Ən naagan banda kwan ndakwan aa vǝlwavǝlǝg nǝ uud kǝ ghǝra Yuhwan dadda tsuufǝg tǝ pǝlaiya.”
Cinngha ba nǝ iin kwana, kaa njikǝnjiig ba vaivaiya, amaa mbakyarvad ngwaɗǝgi zuu nǝ iina, ar dǝ ghwulabahaana, naabi kǝ pigardapiig biya.
Kaa bǝlgantɓǝlǝg kǝ iin kǝ kapupuwaan taakiya aa sǝvardaasǝg ghǝra Yuhwan. Kaa dagau kǝ iin damma guda bǝrfin ghwudda kǝ ghǝra Yuhwana.
Sǝdaa kǝiin tǝ pǝlaiya, vǝlar kǝ dǝghwiina, dǝghwǝn dlaɓa vǝlar kǝ babbaana.
Cinngaraba mbǝrzaha Yuhwana, kaa dagau kǝ iitǝr ar kǝsant kǝ tluwaana, ar hǝɗnana.
Gǝlghantgǝlǝg Yesu kǝ Uudaha lǝffu Dlǝɓa
Gwiyaragwiig dlakulva gyiya Yesu kwa ɓǝlatǝrǝt nǝ iinǝn saasa vakaana, ar tagar kǝ dǝgitahi ɓagara nǝ iitǝr baɗǝmma, ar dǝ dǝgiti tsagaar nǝ iitǝra.

Aɗaba uudah baɗyaka ba kwan daasa kwan sagala, bandva kaffa tlarkǝnai zǝrɓǝlgahaan kǝ ɗuula zǝgaan biya, aiyama taa kǝ iitǝra, “Jiyam dagal da vakavaki maay aanji ndǝwar biya, am ɗiida kuɗǝg hǝɗikǝna.”
Kaa dǝgǝdmǝg kǝ iitǝr damma pɛrrayiwa ar dal da vakavaki maay aanji ndǝwarbi ba iitǝr davaatǝra.
Nǝghara ba nǝ uudah baɗyak kǝ ciya dagalatǝra, dlaɓa nǝghartǝraakanǝghǝga. Kaa ǝmndǝra dagal kǝ iitǝr ba dǝ shǝg sagal ma kǝsah baɗǝmma, kaa tsugwatsug kǝ iitǝr lakuti sagau kǝ iitǝra.
Tsugwa ba nǝ Yesu kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ uudah faɗǝgaan ba baɗyaka, zhutǝrdaala kǝ iina, Aɗaba ar band tuughah kwal dadda piiga. Kaa tsagtǝrtsag kǝ iin kǝ dǝgitah baɗyaka.
Hǝrz faci ɓǝladaya kaa sagau kǝ mbǝrzahaan da vakaana, am nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ iina, “Vaakwana maay ndǝwar biya. Faci dlaɓa hǝrz ɓǝladayaana.
Ɓǝlarsɓǝlǝg kǝ uudah maraa dal damma gǝdzǝrkǝssaha ar dǝ kǝssahaan mbɛvmbɛvǝn, maraa sagwa kǝ dǝgitahi da zǝ nǝ iitǝr.”
Ngwatǝrangwug Yesu amaa, “Vǝlamtǝrvǝlǝg nǝ uuram kǝ dǝg zǝgga.” Aiyam nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ iina, “Kǝm sugudasug kǝ dǝgzǝg kalkal dǝ kwaɓi ɗivar kǝ baryam dǝga kyil tǝhs, kǝm vǝltǝr ar zuwa?”
Amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Bruudi ngwen wa vakaruwi? Dam da vazǝgaana.” Vazarna ba nǝ iitǝra, aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Bruudi dlǝɓa, ar dǝ kilf buwa.”
Kaa tagtǝrtag Yesu kǝ mbǝrzahaan aa tagartǝrtag kǝ uudah ar cahwara dakwal dakwala tǝ kazhakw dǝ gyiya.
Kaa cahwargacahwarǝg kǝ iitǝr dakwal dakwala, kyalǝm dǝrmǝk-dǝrmǝka, kyalǝm kul dlǝɓ kul dlǝɓa.

Kǝsghant ba nǝ iin kǝ ɗummba bruudi dlǝɓa, ar dǝ kilf buwna, dzǝgaan kǝ iin kǝ ghǝraan damma zhigǝl, tagar kǝ uus kǝ Daadamazhigǝla, lahnana kǝ iin kǝ ɗummbahaana vǝltǝr kǝ mbǝzahaana, ar vǝlar kǝ uudaha. Tagwtǝrnan dlaɓ kǝ kilf buuna kǝ mbǝrzahaan ar valtǝr kǝ uudah ba ɗǝmma.
Baɗǝmma zaruuzǝg tlatǝrtlǝga,
ar dzahant kǝ lahgaha bruudi ar dǝ kilfiina, tlavkǝna nǝ alghw kǝlawa tar buwa righarighan.
Ɗyakǝra uudahi zaru kwanǝn kǝ dǝgzǝga ghwalvah alfu dlǝɓa.
Dal Yesu Tǝghǝra Yuwa
Ba tǝ watsǝra kaa fǝtǝraafǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ mbǝrzahaan damma perrayiwa maraa tsugwa ma Betsaida lakwti dagau kǝ iina, iin dlaɓa ɗiitǝrs kǝ uudaha.
Tǝhalakwa ɗiyatǝrǝs nǝ iin kǝ uudaha, kaa dagat kǝ iin dat kungula aghw da dzugwazhigǝla.
Ɓǝlaa ba hwaasa, pɛrrayuna ndza ma taataka yuwahaiya. Ndza ba dlaɓ nǝ Yesu tǝ ghaiya gardz ba daghwvaana.
Nǝgha ba nǝ iin kǝ dlaɗa ɗuulǝgaanaatǝr kwakyarvad ɓagavanaatǝr dǝ fǝɗa, band garava karfi hǝkǝrɗa avǝɗa. Kaa dagal kǝ iin tǝghǝra yu da vakaatǝra. Zǝkk amaa bandgi da ghuda dagala.
Nǝghara ba nǝ iitǝr dagal tǝ ghǝra yuwa, am nǝ iitǝr ndakwani daddkwa sǝgal tǝ afka, kaa huulǝg kǝ iitǝra,
aɗaba baɗǝm nǝgharanǝghǝga, kaa gǝdzǝg kǝ iitǝra. Kaa tagtǝrtag kǝ iin taakiya, “Ndavam biya! Ba kaiya, gǝdzam biya!”
Kaa daas kǝ iin damma pɛrrayu ǝmtaɗ dǝ iitǝr, kaa ghacgaghacig kǝ fǝɗiina. Kaa ɓa jappǝr kǝ iitǝr ba vaivaiya,
aɗaba ar sǝrgai kǝ dǝgiti tuuk vakai nǝ gǝlla uudah alfu dlǝɓǝn biya, kwakyarvad irrǝviɗmahuɗaatǝra dǝkdǝka.
Mbǝghanimbǝg Yesu Kǝ lii Yang Biya
Dzǝvara ba nǝ iitǝr kǝ yuwa haiya, ar tsugwa ma Janisarat, ar nguɗǝna kǝ pɛrrayuwiin tǝ ghaiya yuwahaiya.
Ba sagalaatǝr wah ma pɛrrayuwa, caaricaari kaa sǝrgaakasǝrǝg kǝ uudah taaki, mbats Yesu.
Kaa ɓala ǝmdǝrg kǝ iitǝr aanji takwar ma haiyin, kaa ba langarlang kǝ iitǝr kǝ lii yang bi tǝ dǝga hǝnganaatǝr da vakavaaki ar cinnga nǝ iitǝr taakiya vaakwah Yesu.

Baɗǝm vakavaki dǝgal nǝ iina, bi kǝs ɗyaka, ma zǝr kǝssa, bi ɓalaɓalaha, ar hǝngna kǝ lii ya yangbi tǝ ghaiya kasukwa, ar ghalǝg mbakyarvad lii yangbi maraa tappǝnan aanji ba ghaiya sǝɗavaana. Baɗǝm lii taparnatapǝgga mbaharambahǝgga.
